title: Lesson record
description: The one record both streams become. Source-agnostic: any source adapter emits it, any memory-system adapter stores it. Canonical copy lives in the memory system (Outline first); the local copy under records/ is a cache the Python side runs on.

memory_ref.description: where the canonical copy lives in the memory system (Outline doc URL or id); optional until the record is pushed

kind.description: history = this homelab's own past, read from the memory system

system.description: adapter name: kuma, graylog, outline, a publication name; the core never branches on it

ref.description: link or id back to the original; never a copy of it

form_hint.description: suggested content forms; Decide may ignore

persona.description: optional persona card input, chosen by trait; no real artist names

evidence.description: each factual claim in the lesson with where it can be checked

method.description: by value, not by field name

signoff.description: Set by a person through the memory system (back and forth in Outline). Unattended CLI runs are generate-only and never write approved.

note_model.description: comment supplied by the assistant; never counts as the human's words
